# Standings: MiniMax-M3.1 on node 0008 (generated by progress_page.py from runs_v3.json + runs_meta.json; do not edit)

SLA: A minute is in SLA when the median first token (TTFT p50) is under 3 s, median generation speed (TPS) is above 60 tokens/s and every request succeeds (success rate 100%). A load passes only when all 15 measured minutes are in SLA. The SLA changed on Oct 1 (before: TTFT p50 ≤ 1 s, TTFT p99 ≤ 15 s, errors ≤ 0.1%); every run with per-minute records is re-scored, and run notes written earlier still quote the old rule.
